items.markdown:
If you have been hurt in a car accident in Brisbane, you will typically be dealing with [Compulsory Third Party (CTP) insurance](https://www.mauriceblackburn.com.au/injury-illness/road-injury/car-accident-lawyers-brisbane-qld/) , and most reputable personal injury firms operate on a **no win, no fee** basis.[[1]](https://bestinjurylawyers.com.au/)[[2]](https://www.mauriceblackburn.com.au/injury-illness/road-injury/car-accident-lawyers-brisbane-qld/)
